_doc.description: Sports hub slice of The T content. Rendered by src/web/features/theT/components/HubPage.tsx via the `sports` entry in `SLUG_RENDERERS` in src/web/features/theT/containers/Hub.tsx. Same shape as ./movies.json / ./shows.json / ./horror.json / ./originals.json — every section (`hero`, `featured`, `storyHero`, `watchlist`, `keepReading`) carries its own `header.{title,subtitle}` + items so the JSON drives both heading and content.
_doc.source: Shell. Hero label + lede + image land first; Featured rail, Story Hero, Watchlist rail, and Keep Reading rail get authored section by section against the upstream `~/Desktop/Static Upload Tubi Blog/{listicles,single-titles,watchlist}.json` slices for `pageLocation: Sports` records.
_doc.doNotInclude: intro, items[], cast[], whatsComing[] — only the fields the Sports hub actually renders should ship in this chunk.
_doc.linking: Every article card / hero uses the canonical URL `/the-t/articles/<slug>`. Each slot stores just the bare `slug`; the renderer (`homePageData.ts → buildArticleHref`) prepends the prefix. The optional `watchLink` on some slots is reserved for CTAs that bypass the article and route straight into the Tubi catalog; it does NOT influence the article href.
